column_description: TEXT. Identifier of the transaction under security review. PK. FK to transactions(EventCode).
REAL. Operational-security metric for the transaction session. Example: 95.7.
REAL. Threat-intelligence index derived from external feeds. Example: 79.2.
REAL. Score indicating detection-avoidance behaviour. Example: 94.65125815301414.
TEXT. Level of anonymity observed. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
REAL. Score indicating how easily the actor can be traced. Example: 14.4.
REAL. Correlation strength between session artefacts. Example: 69.6.
REAL. Pattern-match score against known malicious signatures. Example: 36.5.
REAL. Behavioural risk score for the session. Example: 15.8.
REAL. Machine-learning confidence level for the classification. Example: 97.2.
REAL. Aggregate anomaly score for the session. **NULL means anomaly metric has not been computed.**. Example: 38.9.
REAL. Probability that the detection is a false positive. Example: 10.4.
text. The rate at which threats are handled in the system, measured in Threats/hour. Example: 0.12 Threats/hour.
text. A measure of data protection efficiency, calculated as the ratio of vulnerability count to data protection level, measured in Vulnerabilities/GB. Example: 1.82 Vulnerabilities/GB.
text. The cost of encryption required for the transaction, measured in USD/encryption-bit. Example: 8.21 USD/encryption-bit.
text. A score reflecting the level of traceability in a transaction, associated with the anonymity level, measured in USD/anonymity-point. Example: 51.71 USD/anonymity-point.
text. A metric representing bot activity, calculated as actions per IP per hour, measured in Actions/IP/hour. Example: 40.87 Actions/IP/hour.
text. The diversity of connection durations in a given session, measured in hours. Example: 8.92 hours.

JSONB column. Captures the security metrics for the connection during the transaction, such as IP count, VPN usage, and encryption strength.
